title: Docs + terminal verification: refund-policy failure avoided, provenance correct, no caller branching (runs last)
priority_note: Terminal story: proves the acceptance criteria of #305/#306 end-to-end and documents the hybrid interface + the three-layer model. Depends on all leaves; runs last.

background.reference: GitHub issues #305/#306 acceptance section; mirrors the epic_28/29/30 terminal-verification pattern.
background.includes: Each prior story asserts its slice; this story proves #305/#306's acceptance end-to-end (curated wins, long-tail retrieves, single interface + provenance, the refund-policy failure avoided) and writes docs.

story.i_want_to: run one end-to-end pass proving the hybrid interface satisfies #305/#306's acceptance, and document it (including the three-layer model)
story.so_that: the hybrid knowledge interface ships proven and clearly positioned against agent-memory and the context-retriever

rationale: The headline claim — 'the confidently-wrong answer from an unrelated chunk is avoided when a curated answer exists' — must be demonstrated, not asserted. A terminal end-to-end test plus authoritative docs turns the composed pieces into a trustworthy interface.

acceptance_criteria.description: docs/knowledge-hybrid-retrieval.md is written: the curated-vs-retrieved resolution rule, provenance, progressive disclosure, and where it sits in the three-layer model (Knowledge Wiki hybrid retrieval vs Agent Memory vs Context Retriever). README/CLAUDE/AGENTS/CHANGELOG updated; endpoint at /swaggerui. Notes the #305 'reconcile cole-medin doc' style items and that #305/#306 are the same feature (recommend closing one as a duplicate).

An end-to-end test demonstrates #305/#306 acceptance: (a) a query WITH a curated answer returns THAT flagged curated (not a fuzzy chunk); (b) a long-tail query returns retrieval flagged retrieved; (c) callers read one shape + provenance (no RAG-or-curated branch); (d) the refund-policy-style failure (confident answer from an unrelated chunk) is demonstrably avoided when a curated answer exists.
A tenant-isolation test proves the hybrid interface (resolver + index + API + MCP) never returns another tenant's curated or retrieved content.

test_cases.name: end-to-end: curated wins, long-tail retrieves, refund-policy failure avoided
preconditions: a curated refund-policy article + unrelated fuzzy chunks + a niche non-curated topic
steps: hybrid_search a query whose only fuzzy match is an unrelated chunk but a curated answer exists
expected_results: curated returned + flagged for the policy query; retrieved + flagged for the niche; the unrelated-chunk hallucination is avoided because the curated answer wins

test_cases.name: hybrid interface is tenant-isolated across surfaces
steps: hybrid_search / index / drill as tenant_b for tenant_a topics via context, API, MCP
expected_results: no tenant_a content on any surface

technical_notes: Model on epic_28/29/30 terminal-verification pattern: depends on all leaves, runs last.
docs/knowledge-hybrid-retrieval.md is authoritative; keep it decision-oriented.
